title: Accounts, Purchasing and Admin Assistant
description:
Accounts and Purchasing Administrator

Milton Keynes

Salary: circa £30,000 per annum

Hours 8.30 -5pm

Free Parking

We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established and successful international organisation for an Accounts, Purchasing Administrator to join their busy team in Milton Keynes.

This varied role will support the Accounts, Purchasing and Administration functions, ensuring the smooth running of financial processes while providing administrative support across multiple departments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a hands-on role and thrives in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attention to detail are essential.

The Role

Reporting to the Accounts, Purchasing and Administration Supervisor, you will be responsible for supporting accounts payable, purchasing activities and general office administration.

Key Responsibilities

Accounts Payable & Finance
- Processing and coding supplier invoices
- Posting vouchers and payment transactions within the ERP system
- Managing Accounts Payable ledgers and reconciliations
- Processing employee expenses through Concur and manual systems
- Creating Accounts Payable payment runs
- Performing vendor statement reconciliations
- Investigating and reconciling freight invoices
- Supporting General Ledger reconciliations
- Producing cash requirement reports
- Maintaining supplier records and vendor spreadsheets
- Recording Postponed VAT Accounting transactions

Purchasing
- Raising and issuing purchase orders
- Monitoring goods receipt and supplier invoices
- Supporting supplier management and maintaining competitive pricing
- Conducting supplier research and price comparisons
- Carrying out regular pricing reviews
- Ensuring purchasing procedures are maintained and updated

Administration
- Reviewing credit applications
- Managing petty cash and month-end reporting
- Providing reception cover, including answering calls and welcoming visitors
- Maintaining filing systems and company records
- Coordinating travel, accommodation and visitor arrangements
- Supporting trade show administration and expenditure tracking
- Monitoring and distributing marketing materials
- Providing general administrative support across departments
- Supporting Accounts Receivable and wider administration teams when required

About You

To be successful in this role, you will have:
- Previous Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Purchasing experience ideally
- Strong administration and organisational skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Strong numerical and analytical abilities
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel
- Experience working with ERP or finance systems
- Ability to work with both manual and semi-automated processes
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills

Personal Attributes
- Self-motivated with a proactive approach
- Strong problem-solving skills and ability to use initiative
- Comfortable working independently and as part of a small team
- Professional, confident and personable manner
- Able to manage multiple priorities and work under pressure
- Highly organised with strong planning skills
- Flexible approach to supporting business needs
- Full driving licence preferred

If you're looking for a varied position that combines accounts, purchasing and administration, and you enjoy working in a collaborative environment where no two days are the same, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Activities Engagement Co-Ordinator
description:
JOB TITLE: Activities Engagement Co-ordinator

REPORTS TO: Registered Manager

ACCOUNTABLE TO: Registered Manager

LOCATION: Milton Keynes

HOURS: 40 hours per week

SALARY: £12.85

Are you ready to advance your nursing career in a specialist neurological service with a supportive, award-winning team? At PJ Care, recognised as the "Best Care Home to Work for in the UK," we offer unparalleled opportunities for growth, development, and job satisfaction.

Why PJ Care?

We are leaders in specialist neurological care and neurorehabilitation, supporting adults with progressive or acquired neurological conditions. Our commitment to Care, Compassion, and Commitment ensures we deliver exceptional care to residents and a positive work environment for our team.

Our Expertise:

At PJ Care, you ll work in a 24-hour nursing team alongside a multidisciplinary group that includes:
- Consultant Clinical Neuropsychologists
- Physiotherapists
- Speech and Language Therapists
- Occupational Therapists
- Therapy Technician
- Engagement Coordinator.

We care for individuals with a wide range of neurological conditions, including:
- Neurodegenerative diseases
- Functional Neurological Disorders (FND)
- Traumatic brain injuries
- Frontal temporal dementias
- Long-term and complex care needs

Key responsibilities:
- To support the clinical teams in improving the intellectual, physical and overall health of the residents.
- Assess, plan, implement and evaluate programmes for resident activities which are multi-faceted, meet their functional needs, and reflect the interests of each resident.
- To organise activities programmes that will maintain interest and progression over a period ensuring that high quality, age appropriate, condition appropriate and best value activities are offered at all times.
- Working with unit-based Activities Champions to develop and implement the residents weekly programmes in consultation with key professionals.
- Implement planned opportunities; ensure these are accessible, equitable and available to all, ensuring a variety that caters for all abilities not just the more active/able.
- Collaborate with the Activities Engagement Co-ordinator on the alternate site to encourage and facilitate a co-ordinated approach.
- Ensure integration of residents across all units and cross site participation of all activities.

All staff employed by PJ Care are individually responsible and expected to safeguard and promote the safety and welfare of all individuals who access PJ Care services to ensure everyone is protected from actual or potential harm.

PJ Care Ltd strongly believes in the promotion of Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion in all areas of life, but particularly in the workspace and is proactive in supporting every member of our team and residents to reach their true potential.

title: Amazon PPC Executive
description:
Amazon PPC Executive

Location: Milton Keynes

Our client is looking for an Amazon PPC Executive to join their team on a full time permeant basis. As an Amazon PPC Executive, you will be at the forefront of managing and optimising Amazon advertising campaigns to drive traffic and sales. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, analytical skills, and strong communication abilities. You will play a pivotal role in the company's marketing efforts, ensuring that advertising campaigns are performing optimally and contributing to the business's success.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:
- Conduct keyword research to identify relevant and high-traffic keywords for ad campaigns.
- Create and launch PPC campaigns on Amazon using tools such as Amazon Advertising Console.
- Write compelling ad copy that accurately represents the product and entices customers to click.
- Monitor and adjust bids to ensure optimal campaign performance while staying within budget.
- Analyse campaign data and make adjustments to improve performance, such as targeting and ad placement.
- Produce reports that clearly communicate campaign results and insights to the team.
- Conduct A/B tests to determine the most effective ad copy, keywords, and targeting strategies.
- Manage advertising budgets to align spending with business goals and objectives.
- Analyse competitor advertising campaigns to identify opportunities and threats.
- Stay up-to-date with industry trends and changes to Amazon's advertising platform.

Skills and Experience:
- Proven expertise in PPC advertising principles and best practices.
- Strong analytical skills to analyse campaign performance data and produce insightful reports.
- Knowledge of keyword research tools and techniques.
- Ability to write compelling and effective ad copy.
- Experience managing bid strategies and budgets for optimal campaign performance.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively across various teams.
- Attention to detail to ensure campaigns are set up and managed correctly.
- A willingness to stay current with industry trends and changes.

Company Benefits:
- Casual dress
- On-site parking
- Regular social events including summer and end-of-year parties
- Spontaneous employee well-being treats
- Vouchers at Christmas to shop with the company
- Private medical insurance
- Gym membership discounts

title: Branch Coordinator
description:
WSR is recruiting for a Branch Coordinator for our reputable client in Milton Keynes.

Role Type: Permanent Part Time

Location: Milton Keynes - Hybrid

Hours: Part-Time 16 hours p/w Flexible Hybrid working

Salary: £28k pro rata (£14.50 p/h)

Are you passionate about making a genuine difference to the lives of children and families?

We have a fantastic opportunity for a compassionate, enthusiastic and proactive Branch Coordinator to join a dedicated charity supporting families of children with additional needs, disabilities and life-limiting conditions.

This is an incredibly rewarding opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, building relationships and making a positive impact within their local community.

No two days will be the same! From providing practical and emotional support to families, to organising exciting activities and community events, you'll play an important role in bringing families together and ensuring they have access to the support they need.

Branch Coordinator Key Responsibilities:
- Providing practical and emotional support to families navigating the challenges of raising children with additional needs or disabilities.
- Organising and coordinating family activities, coffee mornings, community events and outings.
- Building strong relationships with families, volunteers and local support organisations.
- Working alongside schools, local authorities, social services and other professionals to help families access appropriate support.
- Offering guidance and signposting families towards relevant services, including educational support and benefits advice.
- Supporting and coordinating a dedicated team of volunteers.
- Assisting with community events and fundraising initiatives.
- Managing branch administration, maintaining accurate records and ensuring activities run smoothly.

Branch Coordinator Skills, Experience & Qualifications:

We're looking for someone who is naturally caring, approachable and organised, with a genuine passion for supporting children and families.

To be successful, you'll ideally have:
- Previous experience supporting families with disabled children, additional needs or within a similar care, education or support environment.
- A relevant regulated Level 3 qualification in childcare, Early Years or a related field.
- GCSE Maths or English at grade C/4 or above, or equivalent.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build trust and positive relationships.
- A compassionate, patient and non-judgemental approach when supporting vulnerable families.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage a varied workload independently.
- Good IT skills, including experience using databases or CRM systems.
- An understanding of social media and digital communication.
- Access to your own transport, as occasional travel within the community will be required.

Experience working within the charity or voluntary sector, or knowledge of fundraising platforms, would be advantageous.

We would particularly welcome applications from individuals with personal experience of raising or caring for a child with additional needs or disabilities.

Branch Coordinator Benefits:
- Hours: 16 hours per week, with flexibility around working patterns.
- Location: Milton Keynes a combination of home working and community-based activities.
- Holiday: 28 days annual leave, including bank holidays (pro rata).
- Benefits: Pension contributions, health and wellbeing support and reimbursed business travel expenses.
- Flexibility: Potential to consider alternative working hours or job-sharing arrangements.

Ready to Make a Difference?

If you're looking for more than just a job and want to be part of something truly meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

This is your opportunity to use your experience, compassion and enthusiasm to make a real difference to families who need it most.

Please click APPLY NOW , or call the WSR Team at for more info. We appreciate the time and effort invested in your application.

While we strive to respond to all applicants promptly, we kindly ask for your understanding in case of delays. If you do not hear from us within 10 days of submitting your application, please assume that, unfortunately, you have not been successful this time.

We will however keep your CV on file and review your suitability against any other vacancies we may have available.

title: Credit Controller
company: Oasis Business Personnel Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Credit Controller - Permanent - based in Milton Keynes, MK9 (Hybrid)

Job Purpose:

We are seeking an experienced Credit Controller to join a well-established specialist business within the industrial automation sector, based in Milton Keynes. This is a permanent, full-time position offering hybrid working within a professional and customer-focused environment.

As part of the Credit Control team, you will take ownership of your own sales ledger, keeping debt under control and maximising cash collection while supporting the sales function with sound credit decisions. You will be the main point of contact for customers on account matters and will work alongside internal departments to resolve queries and reduce credit risk.

The position would suit a dependable, highly organised credit professional who brings drive and initiative, takes a disciplined approach to detail and enjoys working towards monthly collection targets.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
- Take ownership of an allocated sales ledger, chasing outstanding balances to ensure payments are received on time.
- Contact customers by telephone and in writing to recover overdue debts.
- Agree payment settlements with customers on overdue balances and authorise the release of held orders where appropriate.
- Respond to customer account queries, working with internal departments to reach a prompt resolution.
- Review customer credit risk on a regular basis and set up new credit accounts.
- Determine and manage suitable credit limits for customers.
- Work with the sales team to find commercially sensible solutions when extending credit to customers.
- Reduce the company's exposure to credit risk, escalating matters where required.
- Keep detailed and current records of all customer contact and collection activity within the relevant systems and reports.
- Complete ad hoc tasks set by the Credit Supervisor or Credit Manager to help meet monthly collection targets.
- Provide cover for colleagues within the Credit Control team during periods of absence.

Person Specification:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Proactive problem-solver, able to resolve account queries effectively.
- Well organised and dependable.
- Thorough, disciplined and detail-focused, with the ability to analyse logical and detailed data.
- Committed to following clearly defined processes.
- Driven, with initiative and vision.

Experience:
- Previous credit control experience is essential.
- A good standard of education, including GCSE English and Maths at grade A-C (or equivalent), is essential.

Hours of Work:
- Monday - Friday (37.5 hours)

Work Location:
- Milton Keynes (Hybrid)

Benefits:
- Competitive salary package.
- Performance Bonus: Monthly commission scheme linked to individual performance and targets.
- Annual Leave: 25 days' holiday, rising with service to 30 days, with the option to buy or sell up to five days, plus up to five additional days' holiday in an anniversary year.
- Pension, Life Assurance & Shares: Group personal pension with a 5% employer contribution, life assurance at 2x salary and eligibility for free shares after three years' service.
- Health & Wellbeing: Cashback wellbeing scheme, 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme, Mental Health First Aiders and discounted gym memberships.
- Learning & Development: One hour of protected development time each week.
- Family & Lifestyle: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave, paid volunteering time, workplace giving opportunities and a salary sacrifice cycle scheme.
- Recognition & Rewards: Discretionary on-the-spot and values-based awards, long-service milestone gifts, referral bonuses and an employee discounts portal.

If you are interested, please get in touch ASAP or if this is not the exact role you are searching for, please do not hesitate to contact me directly to discuss other opportunities.

title: Credit Controller (Part Time Hours)
description:
Credit Controller - Part Time

Location: Milton Keynes

Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00am-1.00pm (Some flexibility can be discussed)

Department: Finance

Reporting to: Financial Controller

£32,000p/a Pro-Rata - 20 Hours per week

Role Purpose

The Credit Controller will be responsible for the day-to-day management of the sales ledger and credit control function, ensuring customer receipts are accurately recorded, outstanding debts are actively managed and customer accounts are maintained effectively.

The role will work closely with customers and colleagues across the business to resolve account queries, maintain appropriate credit terms and support strong cash collection.

As part of the wider Finance team, the role will also provide general finance support and cover where required.

Key Responsibilities

Credit Control & Debt Collection
- Proactively chase customers for payment of outstanding invoices by telephone and email.
- Manage the aged debtor ledger, prioritising overdue and higher-risk accounts.
- Support new customer credit checks and the setting or review of appropriate credit limits.
- Run and review the aged debtor report regularly, identifying overdue balances and required actions.
- Escalate significantly overdue accounts, payment concerns and potential bad debts to the Financial Controller.
- Build effective relationships with customers to encourage prompt payment whilst maintaining good commercial relationships.
- Work with colleagues across Sales, Customer Service and other areas of the business to resolve invoice and payment queries quickly.

Daily Banking & Cash Allocation
- Review customer receipts on a daily basis.
- Post daily customer receipts and banking transactions accurately to the accounting system.
- Allocate receipts against the appropriate customer invoices and accounts.
- Investigate unidentified, underpaid or overpaid receipts.
- Ensure customer accounts are kept accurate and up to date.

Customer Statements & Account Management
- Prepare and send customer statements, reminder letters on a regular basis.
- Respond to customer account and statement queries.
- Reconcile customer accounts where required and investigate outstanding differences.
- Ensure customer master data and credit control information is maintained accurately.

Wider Finance Support
- Provide cover and support across the Finance team during holidays, absence and busy periods.
- Assist with general finance administration and transactional finance activities where required.
- Support month-end reporting relating to debtors, cash receipts and the sales ledger.
- Work collaboratively with other members of Finance to ensure deadlines are achieved.
- Contribute to improvements in finance processes, controls and ways of working.

Skills & Experience

Essential
- Previous experience in a Credit Control, Sales Ledger or Accounts Receivable role.
- Confident chasing customers for overdue payments by both telephone and email.
- Experience of allocating customer receipts and maintaining customer accounts.
- Good understanding of aged debtors, payment terms and credit control processes.
- Good Excel skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Confident communicating with customers and colleagues at different levels of the business.
- Able to organise and prioritise workload independently.

Desirable
- Experience working within a manufacturing, engineering or distribution environment.
- Experience using Sage 200 or a similar accounting/ERP system.
- Experience carrying out customer credit checks and monitoring credit limits.
- Experience supporting month-end finance processes.

Personal Approach

We are looking for someone who is:
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of the debtor ledger.
- Confident but professional when chasing outstanding debt.
- Organised and methodical.
- Commercially aware and able to balance debt collection with maintaining good customer relationships.
- Comfortable communicating issues rather than allowing overdue debts or queries to remain unresolved.
- Flexible and willing to support the wider Finance team when needed.

title: HR Administrator
description:
Keeping people processes running smoothly makes a real difference to every employee, from their first day to their last. As an HR Administrator, you'll help make that happen, ensuring employees receive the right support, information and documentation at every stage of their employment.
You'll be joining a global manufacturing business in Milton Keynes that holds Investors in People Gold accreditation, reflecting its commitment to supporting and developing its workforce. This 12-month maternity cover contract offers the opportunity to get involved in a wide range of people processes, working closely with the management team in an established organisation.
What's in it for you
- Salary of up to 35,000 per annum.
- A 12-month fixed-term contract with a global manufacturing business.
- Flexibility within a full-time position.
- The opportunity to work for an Investors in People Gold accredited employer.
- Exposure to the full employee lifecycle, from recruitment and onboarding to payroll and employee development.
- Involvement in projects, process improvements and initiatives that support the wider workforce.

Your responsibilities as an HR Administrator
- Coordinate recruitment administration, onboarding, right-to-work checks, contractual changes and leaver processes.
- Prepare contracts, offer letters and employment documentation, ensuring records remain accurate and GDPR compliant.
- Support payroll by collating and submitting employee information, including starters, leavers and contractual changes.
- Maintain absence, annual leave and training records, including coordinating learning and development activities.
- Produce reports, maintain employee data and support audits, policy updates and process improvements.
- Work closely with employees, managers and external providers to ensure people processes run efficiently.

What we're looking for in an HR Administrator
- Previous experience in an HR administration or assistant role, with knowledge of employee lifecycle processes.
- A good understanding of UK employment legislation, GDPR and confidential employee data handling.
- Experience preparing employment documentation, maintaining records and supporting payroll administration.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook, with experience using HR systems.
- A CIPD Level 3 or Level 5 qualification would be advantageous but is not essential.

Working hours: Full-time, with flexibility available. Specific working hours to be confirmed.

description:
Logistics Coordinator

Location: Milton Keynes
Salary: £35,(Apply online only)-£37,(Apply online only)
Job Type: Permanent, Full-time
Working Arrangement: Primarily office-based

WSR is recruiting for a Logistics Coordinator on behalf of a growing manufacturing company based in Milton Keynes. Our client provides a range of specialist products for building interiors and has developed a positive, fast-paced and collaborative working environment.

This role will support the end-to-end movement of goods, working closely with the Project Management team, customers, suppliers and third-party logistics providers. You will arrange transport and site deliveries, monitor shipments, maintain accurate records and help ensure consignments arrive on time, within budget and in accordance with customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Arrange transportation and site deliveries in a timely, coordinated and cost-effective manner.
- Work closely with the Project Management team to meet delivery schedules and customer requirements.
- Monitor inbound and outbound freight and track consignments through to delivery.
- Investigate transit delays and assist with route planning across road, rail, air or sea where required.

description:

MFK Recruitment is recruiting a Marketing and Content Coordinator to join a well-established and creative business specialising in live events, event production and experiential projects.

The Role

Working closely with the Managing Director and wider team, you will be responsible for planning, creating and delivering marketing content across multiple channels.

You will have the opportunity to get behind the scenes of live events, capture the work being delivered and turn it into engaging content that showcases the company's creativity, expertise and capabilities.

Alongside content creation, you will help identify new markets, develop targeted campaigns and support the company's ongoing commercial growth.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing and Content Creation
- Plan, manage and maintain the company's marketing and content calendar.
- Create engaging content for social media, websites, email campaigns and other digital platforms.
- Write and edit compelling copy for marketing materials, advertising, case studies and promotional campaigns.
- Design graphics and social media assets using Canva, Adobe or similar creative software.

Digital Marketing and Campaigns
- Manage social media content, including planning, scheduling, publishing and engagement.
- Keep website content accurate, relevant and optimised for search engines.

- Monitor social media performance, website traffic and campaign engagement.

- Work closely with production, projects, design and operational teams to identify marketing opportunities.
- Attend events and project locations to capture authentic content.

Essential Requirements
- Previous experience in marketing, content creation, digital marketing or communications.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including strong copywriting and proofreading abilities.
- Experience creating engaging content for social media and digital platforms.
- Practical experience using Canva, Adobe Creative Suite or similar design software.
- A full UK driving licence and valid passport.
- Willingness to travel and occasionally work evenings or weekends when events require it.

Desirable Experience
- Previous marketing experience within live events, event production, creative agencies or a B2 B environment.
- Experience producing marketing content at live events.
- Knowledge of website content management and SEO best practices.
- Experience developing email marketing campaigns.
- Familiarity with CRM systems and supporting new business development activity.
- Experience producing case studies, client presentations or promotional materials.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys marketing and content creation, rather than simply managing social media accounts.

You will be naturally curious, confident in communicating with different teams and comfortable taking ownership of projects from initial ideas through to delivery.

The ideal candidate will be creative enough to spot a great content opportunity, organised enough to deliver it on time and commercially aware enough to understand how marketing contributes to business growth.

An interest in live events, production, design or the wider creative industries would be particularly beneficial.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join an established business operating within the live events and creative production industry.
- Direct involvement in shaping the company's marketing activities and digital presence.
- Close collaboration with senior management and creative production teams.
- Opportunities to develop your experience across marketing strategy, content production and business development.
